text_overrides.ordinary_1: I'm all right. Nice to have a chat.
text_overrides.ordinary_2: Fairly well. I'm in no hurry.
text_overrides.content_1: I'm in a good mood, actually.
text_overrides.content_2: Feeling good. Glad you came over.
text_overrides.content_3: Well, thank you. Nice to have some company.
text_overrides.stressed_1: I can't seem to stop worrying.
text_overrides.stressed_3: I've got too much on my mind.
